text: The residents in the Tavistock Road and Lexfield Avenue community had requested an all-way stop sign control for that intersection. Although a study was done by Transportation Services which did not warrant the installation of all-way stop control, the residents feel that the lack of controlled crossings creates opportunity for motorists to speed on Tavistock, as there are no stops signs after Exbury Road going westbound.
North York Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Tavistock Road and Lexfield Avenue.
